current_step.work: Implement and verify pipeline, then collect4 training trajectories, estimate4 laws and attempt1 joint fit. Only if PASS_FIT collect2 held trajectories and run frozen evaluation.

reuse.inputs: same repaired Jinan net and fixed demand file as dense v2
reuse.policy: original PhasePressure and original SafePhaseExecutor; no controller retuning

cohorts.seed_check: No occurrence in local experiments/scripts/config manifests before this registration. Remote current run manifests must be checked before execution. Do not silently replace a consumed seed.
cohorts.excluded: 76116801 and its failed fragment/all8 branches; old20 target states, all closed-study calibration/evaluation data; reserved35110701-04. Assign no trajectory window to multiple roles.
cohorts.demand_scope: Same fixed route demand; new seeds vary microscopic randomness, not independent demand days.

proposed_budget.behavior: PP from time0,1s passive observations,10s decisions. One actual trajectory per seed, no counterfactual training arms or loadState.
proposed_budget.failure: Every started trajectory/attempted optimization counts. Stop on first essential observation/execution failure or later failed calibration; no retries/replacement/tuning on held seeds.
execution_order: Finish and freeze the full engine/feature extractor/likelihood/collector/evaluators with synthetic closure admission before collecting any new data
Collect the4 training trajectories, stopping on first essential measurement failure
Estimate4 nuisance laws and run the one declared jointGLM optimization from training only; stop on fit failure
Freeze all parameters, then collect the2 calibration trajectories without any model refit, stopping on essential measurement failure
Evaluate all4 fixed windows once and retain every completed seed; failed accuracy gate closes candidate

model.family: One physical packet kernel plus joint low-capacity generalized linear residual/decision heads; no scalar cost head.
model.known_vehicle_parameters: Actual observed profiles are shared inputs, never relearned as evidence of transfer. Predicted future allowed speed is derived from current predicted lane/static limit and stored profile; no future getter.

motion.definition: dt=1s; v is current speed, last_a is separately observed signed acceleration; a_max,b,tau are the positive accel_mps2,decel_mps2,tau_s profile values. b is the nominal braking scale, not an emergency deceleration bound. Vehicle leader gap g=max(front-to-rear gap-min_gap,0); vL,bL are leader speed/deceleration. A stopline blocker instead uses g=distance_to_line,vL=0,bL=b. Omit leader bounds when absent.
motion.approximate_mechanistic_bound: v_safe=max(0,-b*tau+sqrt((b*tau)^2+2*b*g+(b/bL)*vL^2)); omit leader bound on a free road. This is a declared approximation, not an exact SUMO law or safety proof.
motion.mean_proposal: Let U=max(0,min(v_allowed,v+a_max*dt,v_safe,D_admissible/dt)), omitting absent leader/travel constraints; D_admissible is the nonnegative travel permitted by the deterministic path/receiving/conflict resolver. v_base=U, r=clip(w_motion dot phi,-b*dt,a_max*dt), final mean speed mu=clip(v_base+r,0,U). Euler travel=mu*dt. Reapply every upper bound after residual; never infer a_max from last_a. Stronger-than-nominal braking forced by geometry is a declared approximation; report its rate, not a safety claim.
motion.intersection: For a movement, red creates an upstream stopline blocker; yellow admission is fixed by current braking distance versus distance-to-line. G/g and directed foes/yields remain distinct. g-entry willingness uses its learned head only after physical receiving/conflict admissibility. A packet already inside continues along its committed internal path even if the entry signal changes. END intent terminates at the road end without consulting the next signal.
motion.projection: Do not move through an unavailable receiving gap or legal-path constraint. New junction admissions reserve predicted conflict-space travel intervals; directed yielding checks already-internal packets and priority approach arrivals. No traffic-light-level any-G shortcut.
motion.multi_packet_order: Compute longitudinal proposals from the same pre-step packets; resolve front-to-back receiving reservations with priority before yielding and stable physical/FIFO order for exact ties; use predicted movement results for lateral gap checks. No lane/TLS ID as a numeric feature.
motion.residual_identifiability: Because the final upper bound includes v_base, positive residuals can saturate; the learned motion correction is a slowdown relative to the declared upper-bound base. Positive residual saturation is reported, not presented as identified acceleration improvement.

heads.motion: bounded linear residual of next speed
heads.start: Bernoulli logit when current v<0.1 and structurally able to move; memoryless, no unobserved wait-age
heads.yield_entry: Bernoulli logit for a physically admissible yielding connection whose front could reach its entry in this step
heads.lane_change: left/stay/right softmax with logits from the same pre-step causal state as training; execute after longitudinal movement, with hard adjacency/gap masks from predicted intermediate packets. Stay is the reference logit. No observed next-step lateral environment enters features.

model.feature_semantics: Current physical state/local leaders, exact intended legal connection, directed conflicts and current receiving space only. Gap variables are geometrical free space if no vehicle is present; present/masked relations remain explicit. No empirical RMS division, city/phase indices, routes, costs or future PP plan.
model.latent_intent: On entry to each ordinary road, draw a persistent legal movement or END from target-history priors. At an anchor sample from the same prior conditioned on observed current lane and past traversals. Keep the intention across seconds/lane changes; choose a legal physical connection consistent with it. Already occupied internal paths are observed current state. Never resample a blocked intention to force throughput.
model.target_intent_law: Use complete historical road-exit events at/before training-end; END is a separate outcome even when static successors exist. Right-censored road visits do not label non-END. Road-level probabilities shrink with strength8 to the masked network direction/END law with0.5 pseudocount per legal outcome. No individual realized future link becomes a feature.
model.boundary: Global due rate is inferred from past inserted identities plus changes in observed global pending inventory. Entry mixture uses observed historical insertions, never XML per-entry due labels. Unknown initial pending entries are latent draws from the training mixture and stay assigned while blocked. Future due counts are generated by Poisson(training global rate); profile draws use training observations; actual due schedules/arrivals remain labels. Global-rate plus insertion-mixture allocation is an approximation under entry blockage.
model.body_and_sensors: Advance fronts longitudinally then change lanes, preserving the separate traversed front path and native remapped occupancy body trail; insert newly due/pending packets using receiving space. Reconstruct N/H/O/meanSpeed from predicted packets with v2 semantics. Cost uses speed<0.1, not isStopped.
model.update_order: Request originalPP from own state at epochs; apply signals; propagate packets/insertions; aggregate sensors; Advance original executor with predicted internal N; repeat. No true intermediate reset.

training.optimizer: One joint L-BFGS-B solve with analytic gradients, zero coefficient initialization,maxiter200,gtol1e-7; non-convergence is reported and stops, no optimizer scan
training.loss: Equal-weight mean conditional NLL per eligible head plus fixedL2=1e-3 on non-intercept coefficients. Motion is fixed-sigma1m/s Gaussian; decision heads use categorical likelihood. Unknown intent is marginalized under the same training-law prior for each conditional likelihood, never replaced with that vehicle actual future link.
training.sample_cap: One fixed reservoir of at most10000 eligible records per head per training seed, uniform within that head/seed; random seed76116999. No control-cost selection. Keep every observed transition as paid data, even when not sampled for optimizer.
training.label_masks: Speed likelihood applies to observed surviving vehicles, not a fabricated zero speed for disappeared vehicles. The same latent-intent prior is used in every head; training eligibility is declared by current geometry/current v (plus observed next speed availability for the Gaussian label), not a favorable future cost. END/road-exit laws use only complete training road visits; censored visits remain censored.

label_risk_and_likelihood.features: For every packet/current state and candidate intent k, build phi(S_t,k) without the actual future link. Priors pi_k are the frozen target training history law. Observed future speed/entry/lateral/exit supply labels only.
label_risk_and_likelihood.risk_sets: Form head risk sets using current state and the union of candidate-intent admissibility, not observed successful passage. Structurally impossible intents have probability0 for a positive start/pass/change, not an invented compatible connection. Keep blocked and unsuccessful cases in their risk set.
label_risk_and_likelihood.motion: A Gaussian label is available when the packet is observed at both endpoints. Its mean is the final projected speed, not an unprojected residual target. Fixedsigma1m/s is the likelihood scale only; no additional Gaussian speed noise is sampled during rollout. END exits have no fabricated next-speed label.
label_risk_and_likelihood.start: For every currently halted packet (v<0.1), label next speed>=0.1 when next speed is observed. Use Bernoulli start probability times current-intent structural movement admissibility. Likelihood is marginalized over pi_k; no actual next link chooses the head input.
label_risk_and_likelihood.yield_entry: For an ordinary-road packet, include it if some candidate g-connection can be reached within1s under current speed+a_max and current geometric receiving/conflict admissibility. Label any observed entry from that approach into a compatible internal path; no entry is0. Incompatible/red/not-reachable intents contribute structural0. No eligibility by observed actual crossing.
label_risk_and_likelihood.lane_change: When current/zero-residual candidate path has a possible ordinary-road lateral choice, label left/stay/right from the last same-edge lateral segment of the observed front path (including connection_then_lane_change). No lateral segment means stay. Risk includes observed stays. Legal masks/contexts use the frozen pre-step candidate calculation; actual next link is not a feature.
label_risk_and_likelihood.composite_loss: For each head h use -(1/n_h)sum_i log(sum_k pi_ik*p_h(y_ih|S_i,k;theta_h)); sum the4 head means with equal weight and fixedL2. Missing speed labels do not become zero; structural-zero hypotheses remain in the mixture. This is a declared composite likelihood, not a joint latent trajectory likelihood.

intent_connection_resolution.intent: Persist an outgoing ordinary-road/direction or END, not a secretly observed individual route. Internal entry commits the exact path until reaching the receiving road.
intent_connection_resolution.compatible: At each pre-step, collect static connections from the current lane consistent with the persistent intent. If several remain, select the first in frozen XML connection order; use this exact physical connection for signal/foe/receiving features. Selection changes only when the front lane changes; never choose by actual future flow.
intent_connection_resolution.incompatible: If none exists, retain intent. Find approach lanes on the current road with a compatible connection; compute shortest legal adjacent-lane distances. The projected target is the nearest lane, XML-order tie. Motion sees a stopline blocker; entry risk is structurally zero. Signal features are r, receiver/foe fields refer to the static projected target connection in the current pre-state, and masks identify only legal adjacent moves that do not increase distance to the compatible-lane set. No teleport, intent resampling or future-link lookup.
intent_connection_resolution.END: Current lane supportsEND regardless of successors; no junction entry or next signal is needed. Adjacent lane choices use ordinary legal gap constraints.
intent_connection_resolution.lateral_context: All logits use pre-step information. To define the possible receiving-road context for a connection-then-lanechange, use the fixed zero-residual mechanistic proposal and candidate path applied to pre-step packets; do not use observed poststep positions. Apply the actual lateral feasibility mask after predicted longitudinal propagation. Left/right labels come from the observed causal front path, not remapped body trails.

calibration.initialization: Use only observations through anchor; frozen target priors plus causal filtering may update latent state, not model coefficients. No route file, future signal/request/packet/actual entry event during rollout. AllTLS own-statePP thereafter.
calibration.one_step: Separate diagnostic: condition on observed current state and the currently executed signal/action, predict one next step. Report packet speed, laneN/H/O, flow/terminal error; label it conditional one-step. Never substitute its results for free rollout.
calibration.structural_gates: Every scenario/second finite legal states, exact active/pending identity and mass ledgers including generated due/inserted/END exits, legal paths, own-state sensor aggregation and original executor semantics. These require the full transition engine audit; numerical calibration_gates.py alone is insufficient.
calibration.aggregation: For each window use the mean of all8 predicted scenarios; C error is absolute. Average its2 absolute errors within each seed and retain every window. Active metric=sum_s1..450 abs(mean_scenario Ahat_s-A_s)/sum_s1..450 A_s. Terminals are counts over poststeps1..450. Seed-level reporting, no efficacy confidence interval from2 seeds.
calibration.references_to_report: Report frozen H-at-anchor persistence cost forecast as a diagnostic; it does not select model weights or replace the above gates. Neither target controller superiority toPP nor source benefit is a prerequisite of this technical stage.
calibration.stop: Failure closes this one candidate at this data budget, preserving all seeds. Do not adjust heads/features/tolerances on these4 windows. Pass permits a separate T/S/P same-state action-cost protocol only.

cost.units: mean halted vehicles per controlled lane; not trip waiting time
cost.accuracy_scope: 0.05 and0.10 correspond to3240 and6480 halted-vehicle seconds. These are engineering calibration tolerances, not claimed sensitivity to small action effects or evidence of ranking accuracy.

implementation_before_execution: Full pure-Python packet propagation, admission/receiving/conflict resolution, lateral/body remapping and PP/executor adapter
Training-head feature/latent likelihood implementation and fixed sampler
Single-trajectory collector with full logging through1800s and train/cal split
Independent one-step and free450 evaluators; zero-fit synthetic closure cases including nonsink END, internal red changes, blocked boundary, competing G/g and multistep lane changes
Remote seed/runtime/current-run checks, then explicit start decision within this concrete budget
current_deliverable: packet_contract.py provides causal initialization, bounded-speed proposal, persistent intent/pending/END and identity primitives; calibration_gates.py provides numerical gates. Neither is a complete learned transition engine or a completed real-data test.
storage: Raw trajectories, model parameters and large diagnostics remain on the approved server; pull only compact logs/JSON. Do not alter Thesis, closed studies or V93 paper.
next_after_pass: Separately freeze source training amount and placebo, shared target beliefs, action search, new same-state native action-cost evaluation seeds and paired uncertainty before T/S/P. No automatic extra starts or fits.

implementation_clarifications_before_dat.local_training_mean: The projected Gaussian mean uses current-state, zero-residual physical proposals for signal/leader/receiving/foe bounds. Full free network resolution can impose additional limits. This is a local composite conditional objective, not the exact likelihood or expectation of the full stochastic network transition. No observed next positions or actual future link sets those bounds.
implementation_clarifications_before_dat.sampling: For each head/seed, uniformly reservoir-sample at most10000 cheap current-risk-superset references. Then construct full current-state candidate risks; exclude an all-structural-zero row by the same current-only rule for every label, without refill. Conditional retained rows remain uniform among eligible rows; report retained counts and positive labels outside the risk support. Do not select successful crossings or costs.
implementation_clarifications_before_dat.one_step_diagnostic: Fixed time0,10,...1790, one frozen model scenario76117001;360 conditional steps across2 calibration seeds, no extra accuracy gate. Report speed survival coverage/missing predictions; compare entrant counts rather than join invented entrant IDs to true entrant IDs.
implementation_clarifications_before_dat.motion_clip_derivative: Use a feasible loss-decreasing one-sided derivative at the zero residual upper-bound kink; no gradient at a zero-width interval or outward infeasible improvement. Keep zero initialization/fixed L-BFGS-B.
implementation_clarifications_before_dat.evaluation_parallelism: At most4 in-flight model scenarios. Stop new submissions on first structural failure; preserve all started/completed/failed/NOT_RUN tasks. Only after complete free draws compute truth-based numerical gates; never refit from this panel.
implementation_clarifications_before_dat.one_step_integrity: Both held seeds must complete180 conditional steps each without initialization/structural failures. This is essential record completeness, not an additional prediction-MAE/flow accuracy threshold.
implementation_clarifications_before_dat.training_other_intent_draws: At each selected training frame use fixed seed76116999+training_seed*100000+integer_second for other packets causal prior intents. Focal hypotheses restore intent/connection state; no actual next link or future cost conditions features.
implementation_clarifications_before_dat.start_support: Positive start is next speed>=0.1m/s. Candidate start risk requires its projected upper>=0.1, rather than merely positive creep speed; motion Gaussian remains defined at smaller upper bounds.
